Q1: How should this issue get the `ai/issue-6782` branch it needs for checkout and PR base, given its body has no standalone `Integration branch:` line?
Choices:
A) A maintainer edits this issue body to add `- Integration branch: \`ai/issue-6782\`` as a line on its own (the resolver's exact format), confirms PR #6786 is still open, then posts `/reclarify`. Implementation then follows the spec as written. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Close this issue and make the fix (switch the test to `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()` plus a scoped `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH` patch) directly on PR #6786 through its review/autofix loop, without a separate issue or PR.
C) Implement against `main` anyway. **Note:** this contradicts the issue's own "do not proceed on `main`" rule, and the target test does not exist on `main`, so this would produce a no-op or failing run.
